subject.name: Electronic, Magnetic and Optical Materials
aka: Electronic, Magnetic and Optical Properties of Materials

iitd: Electronic, Optical and Magnetic Properties of Materials
iitb: Electronic, Magnetic and Optical Properties of Materials
manipal: Smart Materials for Micro and Nano Systems

course_used.iitb: Electronic, Magnetic and Optical Properties of Materials (MM 333)
course_used.manipal: Smart Materials for Micro and Nano Systems (MET 4310)

subtopics.t: Smart materials: definition, characteristics and significance
Shape memory alloys: martensitic transformation and pseudoelasticity
Energy harvesting and structural health monitoring

where.course: Smart Materials for Micro and Nano Systems (MET 4310)
topics: Introduction to smart materials and systems
types and properties of smart materials including piezoelectric materials
nanomaterials in smart systems including synthesis methods
carbon nanostructures and nanoparticles for applications
micro and nano systems including microsystem fundamentals
fabrication and characterization including micro/nano fabrication

other_units.name: Electrons in Solids: Band Theory
subtopics: Quantum basics: Schrodinger equation, particle in a box
Free electron theory and Fermi-Dirac distribution
Density of states
Periodic potential: Bloch theorem and Kronig-Penney model
Reciprocal lattice and Brillouin zones
Energy bands and E-k diagrams
Effective mass and charge carriers

other_units.name: Conductors, Semiconductors and Superconductors
subtopics: Conductor and resistor materials; contacts, solders, thermocouples
Semiconductor materials: intrinsic, extrinsic and doping
Direct and indirect band gap; compound semiconductors
p-n junctions and metal-semiconductor contacts
Silicon production and crystal growth: Czochralski, zone melting
Epitaxial films: VPE, MBE and MOCVD
Superconductivity and BCS theory
Type I, Type II and high-Tc superconductors like YBCO

other_units.name: Dielectric and Ferroelectric Materials
subtopics: Polarization mechanisms and dielectric constant
Frequency and temperature dependence; dielectric loss
Dielectric strength and breakdown
Solid, liquid and gaseous insulating materials
Ferroelectricity and barium titanate
Piezoelectric and pyroelectric materials

other_units.name: Magnetic Materials
subtopics: Origin and classification of magnetism: dia, para, ferro, ferri
Curie-Weiss law, exchange interaction and Curie temperature
Magnetic domains, hysteresis and permeability
Magnetic anisotropy and magnetostriction
Soft and hard magnetic materials
Ferrites, garnets and rare-earth permanent magnets
Magnetoresistance and magnetic data storage

other_units.name: Optical and Optoelectronic Materials
subtopics: Optical properties: refractive index, absorption and reflection
Photoconductivity and effect of impurities
Luminescence: photo-, electro- and cathodoluminescence
LED and laser materials; injection lasers
Photodetectors and solar cells
Liquid crystal displays and organic LEDs
Electro-optic effects: Kerr and Pockels; lithium niobate
Optical fibres and their materials
Quantum wells, quantum dots and quantum confinement
